meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览并选择性合并上游 NanoClaw 更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高效管理 NanoClaw 的定制安装更新，支持预览和选择性应用。
copy.tagline_en: Preview and selectively apply upstream updates to your NanoClaw install.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage updates to a customized NanoClaw installation with preview and selective cherry-pick.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把上游 NanoClaw 的新改动合并进你改过的版本:更新前先备份,展示改动范围和冲突文件,让你选择全量合并、挑几个提交或变基,然后解决冲突、跑构建和测试,并提示破坏性变更。它只打开真正冲突的文件来省成本。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 里运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发;它先检查工作区是否干净,不干净会先让你提交或暂存。

say.text: 把上游更新合并进来,先预览一下改动。
say.note: Claude 会先备份并展示变更和冲突预览。

say.text: 只挑选这几个提交合入,不要全量合并。
say.note: 走选择性更新路径,按哈希挑提交。

say.text: 中止更新,只告诉我上游改了什么。
say.note: 停在预览这一步,不改任何文件。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can merge upstream NanoClaw changes into your customized copy: backup, preview changed files/conflicts, choose merge/cherry-pick/rebase, resolve conflicts, build & test, flag breaking changes. Low token usage: only opens conflicted files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run `/update-nanoclaw` in Claude Code. It first checks your working tree is clean; if not, it asks you to commit or stash.

say_en.text: Merge in the upstream update, but preview the changes first.
say_en.note: Claude backs up and shows changes/conflict preview.

say_en.text: Only pick these specific commits, not the full merge.
say_en.note: Selects cherry-pick path by commit hashes.

say_en.text: Abort the update and just tell me what upstream changed.
say_en.note: Stops at the preview, changes nothing.
